tickets.title: A new page instance on every product page view inside their app (**amendment 11, E1, 2026-10-22**)

tickets.outcome: Inside the customer's app every product page view, a return to a product already seen included, opens its own page instance with its own decisions, deadline, receipts and impressions, while a variant switch within the same product does not.

criteria.observable: In the SDK, a page view opened with the same page name and channel but another product (the page view's product key, a new member of the page view's options) opens a new page instance: a new pageInstance on the decision request, its own first-decision deadline (hydrateTimeoutMs from its own first request) and the earlier page view's holds released; leaving a product page and returning to it opens another; today: src/sdk/listen.ts:327 and :398–399 open a new instance only when the page name or the channel changes, so every product page after the first in the app keeps the first one's instance.

authority.locator: E3 · section 2 of amendment 11 (the owner's amendment 2 of 2026-10-22)

tickets.outcome: When a page view opens and whenever the shopper's decisions for it change, the engine sends the decision set over the live connection the page holds; a server, or a page before its connection is up, still asks over HTTPS.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, with a page view open on a connected socket, the engine sends that page view's decision set as a content_decisions frame (the shape src/sdk/core.ts:1195–1197 emits as 'decisions' and listen applies) when the page view opens and after each admitted action that changes its decisions; the set carries the page view's pageInstance, and its records, receipts and exposures are those the snapshot path makes; today: no product code sends content_decisions (it appears only under src/sdk and its tests at 11782ac0).
criteria.proof: The P81 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P81.PU1 in src/units/P81 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The SDK no longer re-requests over HTTPS on a channel signal while the socket is connected: neither a 'connected' status (src/sdk/listen.ts:584) nor an acknowledged action (listen.ts:583) causes a snapshot request; a page view's first list is asked with POST /v1/{tenant}/decisions/snapshot when the connection is not up; the subscribe surface (subscribe, onDecisions, hold, apply) is unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P81 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P81.PU2 in src/units/P81 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The hold per page view (P34) governs what is drawn: a pushed set for a held slot of the same page view leaves it as delivered, a pushed set naming another pageInstance is not drawn, and known absence still restores the defaults; a set that needs personalization consent is neither sent without it (as pushFrame refuses, src/durable-objects/ShopperReflex.ts:1869–1885) nor emitted by the SDK (core.ts:1196).

tickets.title: Approved layouts enforced as a publication rule (N2) (**amendment 11, E13, 2026-10-22**)

authority.locator: E13 · section 2 of amendment 11 (the owner's amendment 2 of 2026-10-22)
authority.requirement: see amendment 11 section 2, item E13 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A per-context order for a page is refused at publication unless it is one of the page's approved layouts, and the approved set is itself a published, versioned document.

criteria.observable: The approved layouts of a page, per page and device, are a published, versioned document with history, revisions, validate and rollback like the other configuration documents; today: none exists (the content kinds are catalog, slots, learn, priors and vocabulary: src/routes/content.ts:83–93).
criteria.proof: The P88 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P88.AL1 in src/units/P88 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Publishing a slots document whose per-context order on the declared layout slot is not one of the page's approved layouts for its device is refused 422 naming the page, the context and the order, writing nothing; an approved order publishes as today; today: validateOrders (src/content/kinds.ts:508, applied at :1042) checks an order against the slot's take, pins and exclusions only.
criteria.proof: The P88 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P88.AL2 in src/units/P88 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: P01 O1–O5 and P04's pin rules unchanged for approved orders; the kit states the rule and the document (kit 02 :450 and :1585).
criteria.proof: The P88 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P88.AL3 in src/units/P88 and they pass.

tickets.title: The shopper's shot order carried between page views and into the next first landing, with corrections after sign-in (**amendment 11, E14, 2026-10-22**)

authority.locator: E14 · section 2 of amendment 11 (the owner's amendment 2 of 2026-10-22)
authority.requirement: see amendment 11 section 2, item E14 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: The shopper's latest carousel shot order follows them: delivered over the live connection, kept in the browser for the next page view and the next first landing, corrected after a sign-in or a merge, and never applied to a carousel already on screen.

criteria.observable: The engine delivers the shopper's latest shot order (the order of shot-type tags the carousel decision ranked by) over the live connection when it changes, on both hosts; today: no shot order is computed or sent.
criteria.proof: The P89 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P89.SO1 in src/units/P89 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The SDK keeps the latest shot order in first-party storage under the tenant's key, and the head script (P84) applies it on the next page view and the next first landing as it applies a context's row; a browser whose storage was cleared lands as a new shopper; a delivery during a page view changes no slide already drawn.
criteria.proof: The P89 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P89.SO2 in src/units/P89 and they pass.

criteria.observable: After a sign-in or a merge, the next page view uses the corrected order the engine sends for the merged shopper; a sign-out, an identity change or a personalization refusal clears the stored order.
criteria.proof: The P89 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P89.SO3 in src/units/P89 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The kit states the carried order, its storage and its corrections (kit 01 beside the live connection's frames :420–435; kit 03's frame table :1992).
criteria.proof: The P89 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P89.SO4 in src/units/P89 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.
